## 1. What MIN MURASU Does
MIN MURASU is a digital growth agency and automation engineering consultancy. Unlike traditional marketing agencies that focus only on vanity metrics (likes, impressions, and click counts), MIN MURASU engineers complete growth pipelines:
1. Attracting qualified commercial buyers through Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), and performance ads (Google Search & Meta).
2. Converting clicks into high-value enquiries using custom Next.js web applications engineered for sub-second load times on mobile devices.
3. Automating lead response and appointment confirmations via WhatsApp Business API workflows and direct CRM webhook routing within 60 seconds of enquiry submission.

---

## 2. Core Services Breakdown

### A. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) & Local 3-Pack
- Focus: Generating consistent organic search enquiries from buyers in Coimbatore, Chennai, Bengaluru, and across India.
- Capabilities: Technical SEO audits, site speed optimization, schema.org JSON-LD semantic structure, Google Search Console indexation fixes, keyword cluster mapping, and Google Business Profile optimization for local map pack dominance.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/seo-local-seo

### B. Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)
- Focus: Ensuring that AI assistants (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) cite your brand as the trusted answer when buyers ask conversational commercial questions.
- Capabilities: Brand entity structuring, knowledge graph optimization, schema markup (Organization, Service, FAQ, Person), citation authority indexing, and answer-ready plain copy.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/generative-engine-optimisation

### C. Website & Landing Page Engineering
- Focus: Eliminating mobile bounce rates and conversion friction.
- Capabilities: Bespoke Next.js 16 / React 19 web applications with sub-second page loads (<800ms) on 4G networks, mobile-first UX, zero bloat, accessibility standards, and clean semantic markup.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/website-landing-pages

### D. Performance Advertising (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
- Focus: Profitable customer acquisition targeting high-commercial-intent keywords.
- Capabilities: Search campaigns, conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager and Meta Conversions API (CAPI), ad copy A/B testing, and negative keyword filtering to eliminate wasted ad spend.
- Guarantee: 0% markup on advertising media spend. Clients pay Google and Meta directly.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/paid-advertising

### E. AI & WhatsApp Lead Automation
- Focus: Reducing lead response time from hours to under 60 seconds to prevent lead decay.
- Capabilities: Automated WhatsApp Business API qualification, brochure and floor plan distribution, clinic appointment triage, and two-way CRM integration (Zoho, HubSpot, LeadSquared, Google Sheets).
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/ai-automation

### F. Analytics, Conversion Tracking & Attribution
- Focus: Giving business leaders visibility into true cost per qualified deal.
- Capabilities: GA4, Google Tag Manager server-side tracking, Meta CAPI, multi-touch attribution, and live Looker Studio executive dashboards.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/services/analytics-tracking

## 3. Industry Playbooks

### Healthcare Providers & Multi-Specialty Clinics
- Problem: High no-show rates for consultations, difficulty competing with aggregators for specialty keywords.
- Solution: Medical specialty local SEO, clean doctor credential profiles, transparent treatment overviews, and instant automated WhatsApp appointment confirmations with Google Maps directions.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/industries/healthcare-clinics

### Real Estate & Property Developers
- Problem: Sales teams swamped with unqualified portal leads; buyers bouncing before seeing floor plans.
- Solution: Project microsites built in Next.js, targeted geo-fenced ads, and automated WhatsApp brochure unlocks requiring budget confirmation before download.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/industries/real-estate

### Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering SMEs
- Problem: Relying solely on trade shows and word-of-mouth with no inbound digital procurement channel.
- Solution: Technical component catalogue SEO targeting exact engineering tolerances, OEM specifications, and drawing/CAD RFQ submission portals.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/industries/manufacturing-b2b

### Retail & E-Commerce Brands
- Problem: Rising customer acquisition costs and abandoned carts.
- Solution: Catalogue performance ads, sub-second product pages, and automated WhatsApp abandoned checkout reminders.
- URL: https://www.minmurasu.digital/industries/retail-ecommerce
